## Notes

### Publishing work

The Claude GitHub App is installed on this repository (2026-10-30), so sessions can push feature branches and open
pull requests (REST API: `gh api repos/Umerfaizan92/fleet-office-ai/pulls -X POST ...`; GraphQL is blocked). Never push
to main, merge or deploy without the owner. Fallback when a session has no GitHub access (PowerShell, in the
fleet-office-ai folder):

```powershell
git fetch "$HOME\Downloads\<bundle-name>.bundle" phase-03-cinematic-design:phase-03-cinematic-design
git push origin phase-03-cinematic-design
```

Then open a pull request into `main` on GitHub. Deploying to Render stays a separate, owner-approved step.
